### Packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
```

### Read in Files

```{r}
df <- read.csv("/home/nshanbha/KIDS26-Team11/scripts/data_ingestion/combined_metadata.csv")

df <- df %>% mutate(SRM_concat = paste(srm_order_number,srm_sample_number, sep = "-")) %>% relocate(SRM_concat, .after = srm_sample_number)
```

### Basic Summary Stats

```{r}
summary_stats <- function(column, df) {
  unique <- df %>% distinct(.data[[column]]) %>% nrow()
  dupes <- df %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[column]])) %>% count(.data[[column]]) %>% filter(n > 1) %>% summarize(dupes = sum(n - 1))  %>% pull()
  missing <- df %>% filter(is.na(.data[[column]])) %>% nrow() 
  c(column = column, unique = unique, dupes = dupes, missing = missing)
}

column_names <- c("lab_id_number", "sample_name", "srm_order_number", "srm_sample_number")

summary_df <- map_dfr(column_names, summary_stats, df = df) %>% mutate(across(-column, as.numeric))

summary_df %>% pivot_longer(cols = -column, names_to = "category", values_to = "value") %>% ggplot(aes(x = column, y = value, fill = category)) + geom_col(position = "dodge") + xlab("Category") + ylab("Number of Entries") + ggtitle("Distribution of Data") + geom_text(
    aes(label = value),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.3
  ) +  theme_classic()

```

### RNA Sequence Data Verification

```{r}
#4 Check if the file exists in the RNA sequencing file
rna_sequence_data_df <- read.csv("/home/nshanbha/KIDS26-Team11/dataset/sequence_data_exist.txt", col.names = "file", header = FALSE)

rna_sequence_data_df <- rna_sequence_data_df %>% mutate(SRM_sample = str_split_i(file, "/", i = 2)) %>% mutate(SRM_sample = str_split_i(SRM_sample, "-", 2)) %>% mutate(SRM_order = str_split_i(file, "/", i = 3)) %>% mutate(SRM_order = str_split_i(SRM_order, "_", i = 1)) %>% mutate(SRM_concat = paste(SRM_sample, SRM_order, sep = "-")) 

#There are 238 duplicate SRM ids in the rna_sequence_data (they differ by that number in the middle)
rna_sequence_data_df %>% filter(!is.na(SRM_concat)) %>% count(SRM_concat) %>% filter(n > 1) %>% summarize(dupes = sum(n - 1))  

#Take the distinct RNA sequence data SRM ids 
rna_sequence_data_ids <- rna_sequence_data_df %>% distinct(SRM_concat)

#Overlap of RNA SRM ids found in combined df
overlap <- df %>% mutate(is_in_seq_data = if_else(SRM_concat %in% rna_sequence_data_ids, 1, 0)) %>% filter(is_in_seq_data == 1) %>% distinct(SRM_concat)

#Set Difference of RNA SRM ids and Overlap
rna_orphans <- setdiff(rna_sequence_data_ids,overlap) %>% pull() #rna ids that are not found in the df 
rna_sequence_data_df <- rna_sequence_data_df %>% filter(SRM_concat %in% rna_orphans) %>% distinct(SRM_order)

```

### Missing Information

```{r}
missing_multiple_fields <- df %>% filter(is.na(lab_id_number) | is.na(sample_name) | is.na(srm_order_number) | is.na(srm_sample_number))

write.csv(missing_multiple_fields, "/home/nshanbha/KIDS26-Team11/scripts/human_reviewers/weird_lab_id.csv")
```

### Human Verification

```{r}
#1 Duplicate SRM Sample # but DYE different (must flag this, it's an error) - if it's multiplex or 10x barcode, then it is okay
duplicate_SRM_samples <- df %>% group_by(srm_sample_number) %>% filter(n() > 1)

#2 Duplicate DYE but the SRM different (resequenced) - the SRM order and SRM sample act as a unique identifier. If the SRM order and SRM sample are the same, then flag it. In this case, eliminate embryoid bodies
duplicate_DYE <- df %>% group_by(lab_id_number) %>% filter(n() > 1) %>% group_by(lab_id_number, SRM_concat) %>% filter(n() > 1)

#3 Missing SRM Order # - 
missing_SRM_order <- df %>% filter(is.na(srm_order_number))

#4 Missing SRM Sample # - 
missing_SRM_sample <- df %>% filter(is.na(srm_sample_number))

#5 Missing SRM Sample Name -
missing_sample_names <- df %>% filter(is.na(sample_name))

#4 Lab ID fall out of DYE, DY, or SJNorm
weird_lab_id <- df %>% filter(!str_detect(pattern = "DYE|DY|SJMMNOR|MDSEQ", lab_id_number))

write.csv(duplicate_SRM_samples, "/home/nshanbha/KIDS26-Team11/scripts/human_reviewers/duplicate_SRM_samples.csv")
write.csv(duplicate_DYE, "/home/nshanbha/KIDS26-Team11/scripts/human_reviewers/duplicate_DYE.csv")
write.csv(missing_SRM_order, "/home/nshanbha/KIDS26-Team11/scripts/human_reviewers/missing_SRM_order.csv")
write.csv(missing_SRM_sample, "/home/nshanbha/KIDS26-Team11/scripts/human_reviewers/missing_SRM_samples.csv")
write.csv(missing_sample_names, "/home/nshanbha/KIDS26-Team11/scripts/human_reviewers/missing_sample_names.csv")
write.csv(weird_lab_id, "/home/nshanbha/KIDS26-Team11/scripts/human_reviewers/weird_lab_id.csv")
```

```{r}
rbind(duplicate_SRM_samples, duplicate_DYE, missing_SRM_order, missing_SRM_sample, weird_lab_id)
```
